caravans.blurb:
Delta Sapphire – 35ft x 12ft – 2 Bedroom

Introducing the Delta Sapphire, a beautifully appointed holiday home offering generous space and stylish comfort throughout. Spanning 35ft x 12ft, this two-bedroom model is perfectly suited to families and couples looking for a home away from home at Sandy Bay Caravan Park.

Key Features:

Spacious open-plan lounge and dining area, filled with natural light
Fully fitted kitchen with integrated appliances and ample storage
Master bedroom with double bed and built-in wardrobes
Second bedroom ideal for children, guests, or bunks
Modern bathroom with shower, WC, and washbasin
Full gas central heating and double glazing for year-round comfort
Contemporary interior finish with quality soft furnishings throughout

Why the Delta Sapphire?
Combining practical layout with a warm, welcoming feel, the Delta Sapphire is an ideal choice for holidaymakers wanting comfort without compromise. Set within Sandy Bay Caravan Park in Towyn, North Wales, you'll enjoy easy access to the coast, local amenities, and everything the area has to offer.

Ready to view or reserve? Get in touch today to arrange a viewing.
